methodology.scope: Overlay only; it does not replace the executable/token-authority census.
methodology.liquidity: Amounts are current vault/reserve available-balance upper bounds. They are not guaranteed borrowable amounts and are not exploitable value.
methodology.reachability: A recent successful off-curve-authority outflow proves a live exit path. It does not prove an unauthorized caller can satisfy that path or repay a flash loan.
methodology.transactionEnvelope: The exact composed v1 message is not fabricated. Only the observed exit transaction is measured against 4096 bytes and 64 accounts; program-specific construction/simulation remains required.

atomicV1.note: The observed exit alone fitting is not proof the flash-borrow + exit + repay union fits. Build exact instructions, deduplicate metas, serialize a v1 message, and simulate before claiming reachability.
